title: Remove a package using pamac
summary: Use pamac to uninstall software and clean up unused dependencies. This keeps your system tidy by removing orphaned packages.

steps.explain: Remove the specified package and any dependencies that are no longer needed.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the package to remove.

rollback.explain: Reinstall the package if you need it again.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the package to reinstall.

warnings: Removing packages can break software that depends on them.
